description: State consistency on the real packs: world (content/olife_world, headless stock 0.32) + dev gateway + sandbox stub (scripted entities) + 2 bots (content/olife_client, headless stock 0.32, random walk). Per tick: the world's view hash of every session (views[eid]) vs the bot replica hash (entities + applied block changes); chunk read-back; latency; bytes.
